pools.nonbinary_policy: Use the existing separate shared repertoire, taking the union of active forms. Do not mix shared suggestions into sex-specific profiles.

production_recipe.reason: A dedicated local repertoire supports the authored community, given-name forms and optional bynames without inheriting unrelated name pools.
production_recipe.fallback_policy: No generic fallback is required for the delivered stock profiles. A stock content validation failure is an implementation error; preserve builder-edited profiles and report differences rather than padding them.

pools.coverage_exception: None: each installed stock gender/era pool meets the playable floor; evidence scarcity remains documented, not an activation blocker.
pools.source_gender_limitation: Editorial gender assignments do not establish ancient gender morphology.
